sentences.text: Subir Bhattacharya vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 3

03.12.2025
Sl. no. 75
Ct. No. 42
 P.M.
 Crr 5010 Of 2025
 Subir Bhattacharya
 - Vs -
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. M. Shome
 Mr. Subhajit Das
 ... for the petitioner

1 . 
Present petition has been filed for quashing of FIR being Chatterjeehat P.S Case No. 7 of 2024 dated 6th January, 2024 under Section 498A/323/406 / 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel submits that petitioner is father-in- law of the opposite party No. 2.

Learned counsel further submits that around a month before the date of registration petitioner along with his son had gone to the maternal home of opposite party No. 2 for inviting the opposite party No. 2 and her family for rice ceremony of their son.

However,
they did not oblige the petitioner by accepting the invitation and brother filed a false FIR after a month against the petitioner.
3. Learned counsel submits that there is no material against the petitioner in the charge.

4. Issue notice to the State of West Bengal through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor.
Opposite party No. 2 be also served.
5.

6. List this matter in the combined monthly list of February, 2026.
7.
In the meantime petitioner may appear before learned Trial Court through counsel unless their appearance is specifically required by the learned Trial Court.

(Dinesh Kumar Sharma, J.)
